entry.title: What does "post-quantum" actually mean for a Bitcoin L2 when settlement still happens on a non-PQ L1?
entry.summary:
When considering the safety and security of browsing online, it is prudent to avoid clicking on links from unknown or untrusted sources. This practice helps protect against potential cyber threats such as malware, phishing attacks, and other malicious activities designed to compromise personal information or the integrity of one's computer system. By adhering to this cautious approach, both the individual user and wider community benefit from an increased level of security in their online engagements.
Furthermore, sharing knowledge about the risks associated with unsafe links and the importance of digital hygiene can be extremely beneficial. It raises awareness among internet users, empowering them to make informed decisions while navigating online spaces. Education on these topics plays a crucial role in fostering a safer online environment, where users are less vulnerable to cyber threats and more equipped to protect themselves and others from potential harm. Thus, discussing and disseminating best practices for safe browsing not only enhances individual security but also contributes to the collective safety of all internet users.
